about.title: Why I Started Hägvall Labs
about.intro: I’m a developer, and what bugs me most is rarely the code. It’s everything around it: people copying data between systems by hand, waiting on a file from someone else, double-checking things a script could check.
paragraphs: Often the information sits in a legacy business system or a closed web portal. The system does its job, but the connection to the next step is missing. A person ends up moving the data.
That’s why I focus on automating legacy and closed systems. I start by investigating what can actually be connected.
about.maskeraAfter: came from needing it myself. The moment you wire AI into real data, names and personal ID numbers end up in prompts and logs, and I couldn’t find anything that worked well for Swedish.
about.solo: It’s just me. I talk to you, investigate the systems and build the solution.

methodItems.title: Custom Integrations
methodItems.body: I connect systems through the interfaces and data exports available. Where a ready-made connector is missing, I build the part your workflow needs.

methodItems.title: Reverse Engineering
methodItems.body: When documentation falls short, I analyze a system’s interfaces and communication within agreed and permitted access. The result may be a custom adapter or web interface automation.

methodItems.title: AI Where Interpretation Helps
methodItems.body: AI can interpret emails, PDFs and free text. Explicit rules govern checks and updates. Uncertain information goes to a person for review.

about.deliveryBody: You and I agree on permissions, data handling and approval steps. Logs and checks help detect failures and changed interfaces. I document integrations and dependencies so someone else can take over. Support and changes have an agreed scope.

contact.title: Which Systems Do You Want to Connect?
contact.body: Tell me which systems you use, what you do by hand and how often the task comes up. A few lines are enough. You write directly to me, Joel.
contact.stepsTitle: From First Email to a Decision

steps.title: An Initial Call
steps.body: I walk through the workflow with you and see whether the project is a fit. The call is free. Product questions about Maskera are welcome too.

steps.title: A Paid Feasibility Study
steps.body: You approve scope and price before I start. You get my assessment of access, feasibility and how much maintenance a solution would need.

steps.title: You Choose the Next Step
steps.body: If the study shows a practical way forward, you receive a separate quote for a pilot. Or you can stop there and keep the assessment. Timeline and price depend on what the study finds.

projects.title: Selected Projects
projects.intro: Personal builds showing how I create APIs, MCP connectors and integrations where ready-made options are missing. These are my own projects, not client engagements.

webForms.name: Legacy Booking Portal to API and MCP
webForms.problem: The ASP.NET Web Forms booking portal has no API and requires multi-step form clicks in a browser.
webForms.built: A custom adapter and MCP toolset covering login, slot lookup, booking and cancellation from chat or scripts.
webForms.control: Checks booking quota and re-reads the list after every change to confirm the result.
webForms.imageAlt: Screenshot of a local Eneo chat checking available laundry slots and booking through a custom MCP tool built on top of an ASP.NET Web Forms portal.
webForms.imageCaption: The MCP tool running in Eneo (Swedish UI): checking availability, quota and booking directly against the portal.

tillsynRadar.name: Tillsyn Radar
tillsynRadar.problem: Skolinspektionen, IVO, Arbetsmiljöverket and IMY publish supervisory decisions across separate web pages and PDFs with no open API or RSS.
tillsynRadar.built: Automated collection, severity classification, filterable UI, alerts and an MCP server.
tillsynRadar.control: A deterministic gate rejects personal data and Swedish personal ID numbers before storage.
tillsynRadar.imageAlt: Screenshot of Tillsyn Radar in synthetic demo mode showing filters and normalized supervisory decisions from IVO and Skolinspektionen.
tillsynRadar.imageCaption: Synthetic demo data in Tillsyn Radar.

regulatedMcp.name: MCP Connectors for Regulated APIs and AI Platforms
regulatedMcp.problem: Healthcare APIs, authority feeds and legacy portals cannot be called directly as tools inside an AI platform.
regulatedMcp.built: A read-only MCP server for Cambio Open Services (lab results for synthetic test patients) and adapters for Swedish AI platforms such as Eneo.
regulatedMcp.control: Separate read and write tools, machine-readable error states and an offline demo on synthetic test data.
regulatedMcp.imageAlt: Screenshot of a local Eneo chat calling Tillsyn Radar over MCP and rendering a synthetic supervisory decision table with a source link.
regulatedMcp.imageCaption: Eneo calling the MCP tool in demo mode (Swedish UI) and returning a structured answer with a source link.

localInbox.name: Local Document Inbox With Read-Only MCP
localInbox.problem: Letters and receipts sit inside a closed web portal with no open API for personal search.
localInbox.built: A local, searchable inbox and read-only MCP connector so an AI assistant can find the right letter or receipt on the user’s machine.
localInbox.control: Syncs only when the user approves the session directly, with no stored passwords or cloud upload.
localInbox.imageAlt: Screenshot of the local document inbox in synthetic demo mode showing search, sample letter, sample receipt and privacy notice.
localInbox.imageCaption: Synthetic demo mode in the local document inbox (Swedish UI).

jarvisPanel.name: Jarvis Panel
jarvisPanel.problem: Laundry booking, calendar, public transit and music live in separate tools, several without an open API.
jarvisPanel.built: A 7-inch ESPHome touchscreen panel with voice control and custom local integrations in Home Assistant.
jarvisPanel.control: Runs on the local network with explicit calls to each underlying integration.
jarvisPanel.imageAlt: Screenshot of Jarvis Panel showing weather, public transit departures, calendar and a local voice assistant adding an event.
jarvisPanel.imageCaption: Jarvis Panel showing calendar, transit departures and local voice control.
